name: Canonical Studio Starter Pack
description: Canonical Studio schema — the starter-pack base. Schema-only copy synced from canvas studio-seed/canonical-seed.json; keep in sync via sync_core_from_canonical.py (test_core_sync.py guards drift).

itemTypes.name: Audit
itemTypes.description: Audit engagements and assessments — internal audits, SOX testing, compliance reviews, external attestations

itemTypes.name: Risk
itemTypes.description: Enterprise risk register — risks rated inherent-to-residual and mapped to domains and taxonomy tags

itemTypes.name: Control
itemTypes.description: Control library — controls mapped to frameworks and domains, with type, automation, and operating frequency

itemTypes.name: Issue
itemTypes.description: Findings, observations, exceptions and waivers — identification, classification and response; corrective actions are linked Remediation items

itemTypes.name: Remediation
itemTypes.description: Remediation actions — the discrete corrective actions that clear findings and exceptions, each with its own owner, dates, validation method and closure evidence

itemTypes.name: Process
itemTypes.description: Auditable business and IT processes — the entities audits scope over and controls operate within

itemTypes.name: Policy
itemTypes.description: Policy library — policies, standards, procedures, guidelines and charters with ownership, versioning, framework mapping and review cycles

itemTypes.name: System
itemTypes.description: Systems and service-provider register — internal and third-party dependencies tiered by criticality and data exposure, with ownership, assessment cadence, monitoring status and contract dates

itemTypes.name: FSLI
itemTypes.description: Financial-statement line items and TB components — balances, weighted risk criteria, significance conclusions and assertions for SOX/ICFR scoping

itemTypes.name: Compliance Requirement
itemTypes.description: Compliance requirements — framework clauses, controls, criteria and obligations mapped to applicability, implementation status and evidence

itemTypes.name: Personnel
itemTypes.description: People register - the employees, contractors, founders, advisers and service-provider staff who hold roles in the control environment, with engagement status, reporting line, responsibilities, authority and the declared systems scope that access reviews and lifecycle workflows operate against
